INSERT INTO document_node_ids
                   (document_id, revision_id, node_id, path, hash8, ordinal)
               SELECT $1::text::uuid, $2::text::uuid, n, p, h, o
               FROM UNNEST($3::text[], $4::text[], $5::text[], $6::int4[]) AS t(n, p, h, o)
               ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
